meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把回复切换成穴居人短句,输出少六成字
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果嫌 AI 回复太啰嗦,想省点 token 花销。
copy.tagline_en: Switch replies to caveperson-style brevity and cut token use by 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you wish AI outputs were shorter and cheaper, with a playful caveperson vibe.

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 会改用极简的穴居人风格作答:删掉冠词、套话和修饰性词汇,保留技术要点与代码/报错原样;支持 lite、full、ultra 及文言文等不同压缩强度。
howto.when: 当你说出 'caveman mode'、'less tokens' 等关键词,或输入 /caveman 命令时触发;要求更简短回复时也会自动接管。

say.text: 用 caveman mode 回答我
say.note: 切换到默认 full 压缩模式。

say.text: 用 /caveman ultra 说话,再简短些
say.note: 切换 ultra 级压缩,更简短。
进入 wenyan-full,用古典文言文回复。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude answers in ultra-terse caveman style: drops filler, keeps technical accuracy, preserves code and error text. Supports intensity levels lite, full, ultra, and classical-Chinese variants.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'caveman mode', 'less tokens', or 'be brief', on /caveman command, or when token efficiency is requested.
